splash.text: Pehchaan. Money follows, my brother. Money follows.

quotes.native: पहचान। मनी फॉलोज, भाई, मनी फॉलोज।
quotes.roman: Pehchaan. Money follows, bhai, money follows.
quotes.subtitle: Recognition first. Money follows, brother.

quotes.native: మనం బాగున్నపుడు లెక్కలు మాట్లాడకూడదు, కష్టాల్లో ఉన్నప్పుడు విలువలు మాట్లాడకూడదు.
quotes.roman: Manam bagunapudu lekkalu matladakudadu, kastalo unnapudu viluvalu matladakudadu.
quotes.subtitle: When we are well off, we shouldn't talk about calculations; when in trouble, we shouldn't talk about values.
If you have a little money in your hands, you are its boss. If you have money up to your neck, it becomes your boss.

quotes.native: എന്റെ കയ്യിൽ പണം കായ്ക്കണ മരം ഒന്നുമില്ല.
quotes.roman: Ente kayyil panam kaykkan maram onnumilla.
quotes.subtitle: I don't have a money tree in my hand.

quotes.native: ಎಲ್ಲ ಸಿಗತ್ತೆ. ಎಲ್ಲ. ನಿಮಗೆ ಬೇಕಾಗಿರುವುದು ಹಣ ಮಾತ್ರ.
quotes.roman: Ella sigatte. Ella. Nimagē bēkāgiruvudu haṇa mātra.
quotes.subtitle: You'll get everything. Everything. You just need money.
If you looked at your bank balance...
